title: Surreal Rose Poetess
description: A woman in a green Victorian dress sits on a teal ornate sofa, writing in a book with a blue quill while holding a blue heart-shaped vessel containing an anatomical heart and red roses. Above her, a giant stylized mouth with teal lips and a long pink tongue made of ribbons and small faces flows across a purple wall decorated with framed roses and anatomical hearts.
prompt: A surreal Victorian woman with dark hair in an updo sits on an ornate teal sofa wearing a green embroidered dress. She writes with a blue quill in an open book while holding a blue glass heart containing a realistic anatomical heart and red roses. A giant stylized open mouth with teal lips emerges from the purple patchwork wall, its long flowing pink tongue transforming into ribbons, small faces, and roses. The background wall is covered in framed pictures of roses and anatomical hearts, with a wooden desk holding more roses and papers, in a detailed surreal style.
